items.question: What is Blastrr?
items.answer: Blastrr is an advanced simulated trading and performance evaluation platform designed for traders to hone their market strategies in a zero-risk environment. Participants engage with real-time market data using virtual capital, allowing them to test strategies, demonstrate discipline, and earn performance-based simulated rewards without risking personal capital.

items.question: How do I log in to Blastrr?
items.answer: You can log in by visiting the official Blastrr web portal and clicking Connect or Login. Blastrr supports standard email/password authentication as well as Web3 non-custodial wallet connections (such as Phantom or Solflare) depending on your account preferences.

items.question: How long does it take to sign up?
items.answer: Account creation is instantaneous. Once you register your email or connect a supported Web3 wallet, your account dashboard will immediately provide access to your trial or evaluation workspace.

items.question: How do I contact support?
items.answer: Our support team is available 24/7 via the live chat widget on the bottom right of the Blastrr platform, or by submitting a ticket directly through our Discord server and official support email at support@blastrr.com.

items.question: How does the Blastrr referral program work?
items.answer: The Blastrr Referral Program allows users to share a unique referral link generated in their user dashboard. When new participants sign up and purchase evaluation account access using your link, you earn a percentage commission paid out in supported tokens or account discounts.

items.question: I am interested in a partnership or affiliate opportunity. Who should I contact?
items.answer: For media, institutional partnerships, or high-volume affiliate inquiries, please reach out directly to our growth team at partnerships@blastrr.com or open a partnership ticket in our Discord community.

items.question: Is real money required to use Blastrr?
items.answer: No. All trading operations, balances, positions, and performance metrics on Blastrr are conducted strictly using simulated, virtual funds. There is no real-money trading or real capital deposited onto the trading terminal.

items.question: What is a Blastrr Simulated Account?
items.answer: A Blastrr Simulated Account is a sandboxed trading profile provisioned with a designated balance of virtual capital (e.g., $10,000, $50,000, or $100,000 simulated USD). It allows traders to execute simulated orders under realistic market conditions, spreads, and fee models.

items.question: Do I need to deposit my own real capital to trade?
items.answer: No. Users never deposit trading capital onto Blastrr. The only fee required is an optional access fee to enter specific evaluation tiers or instant simulated accounts. Your trading balance consists entirely of virtual testnet tokens.

items.question: Can I purchase an evaluation account if I am logged in with a crypto wallet?
items.answer: Yes. Blastrr supports native Web3 checkout. If you are connected via Phantom, Solflare, or Metamask, you can purchase account access directly using supported tokens (such as SOL, USDC, or $LUN) directly on-chain.

items.question: What payment methods are supported for platform access fees?
items.answer: We accept major credit/debit cards, crypto assets via Web3 wallet payments (USDC, SOL, ETH), and platform reward vouchers.

items.question: My access fee payment shows as complete but I have not received my account. When will it be activated?
items.answer: Account credentials and terminal setup are usually generated within 60 seconds of transaction confirmation. If your account does not appear in your dashboard after 5 minutes, please refresh your session or contact support with your transaction hash/receipt.

items.question: How many simulated accounts can I hold concurrently?
items.answer: Participants may manage up to 5 active evaluation accounts or up to $300,000 in aggregate initial simulated balance at any given time.

items.question: Can I get a refund on account access or evaluation fees?
items.answer: Because platform provisioning and data feeds are initialized immediately upon purchase, access fees are non-refundable once simulated trades have been executed on the account. Refunds are only issued if requested prior to placing any trades within 14 days of purchase.

items.question: What evaluation tiers are available on Blastrr?
items.answer: Blastrr offers single-phase and two-phase evaluation tiers ranging from $10,000 to $100,000 in virtual capital. Each tier has defined virtual profit targets (e.g., 8% or 10%) and strict loss parameters.

items.question: Is there a minimum number of required trading days during evaluation?
items.answer: No. Blastrr has no minimum trading day requirement. If you hit your virtual profit target cleanly in a single day while adhering to all risk rules, you qualify to advance immediately.

items.question: Are recurring fees charged during the Evaluation Phase?
items.answer: No. All Blastrr evaluation tiers require only a one-time setup fee. There are no monthly subscriptions, hidden maintenance fees, or recurring charges.

items.question: What changes when my account advances from Evaluation to Funded status?
items.answer: Once an evaluation is passed, your account transitions to a Simulated Funded Account. In this stage, you no longer have a virtual profit target, but you become eligible to submit reward claims based on your virtual trading performance split.

items.question: What is a Blastrr Instant Account?
items.answer: An Instant Account bypasses the evaluation phase entirely, allowing experienced traders to start operating a simulated funded profile immediately upon setup without hitting a prior profit target.

items.question: What is the Maximum Drawdown limit on each Instant Account size?
items.answer: Instant Accounts carry a static Maximum Drawdown limit ranging from 5% to 6% depending on the account size selected during checkout.

items.question: How quickly can I begin trading after selecting an Instant Account?
items.answer: Instantly. Credentials and platform connection links are rendered in your dashboard within seconds of checkout approval.

items.question: What are the key rules governing an Instant Account?
items.answer: Instant Accounts require strict adherence to the Daily Loss Limit, Max Drawdown, position sizing caps, and prohibited strategy rules (such as latency arbitrage or tick exploitation).

items.question: What is the structural difference between Instant and Evaluation accounts?
items.answer: Evaluation accounts require passing a profit objective first but offer higher virtual leverage and lower setup fees. Instant accounts eliminate the evaluation step but feature tighter static drawdown rules.

items.question: Are there restrictions on trading during high-impact news events?
items.answer: On standard evaluation accounts, news trading is fully permitted. However, on certain specialized Instant Accounts, opening new orders 2 minutes before and 2 minutes after high-impact economic announcements (e.g., CPI, NFP) is prohibited to prevent slippage exploitation.

items.question: Is there a performance or sizing consistency rule applied to trading volume?
items.answer: Yes. To ensure realistic risk management, no single simulated trade can account for more than 50% of your total generated virtual profit at the time of a reward claim submission.

items.question: Are any specific algorithmic or manual trading strategies prohibited?
items.answer: Prohibited practices include:Latency arbitrage or high-frequency tick manipulation.Exploiting platform/feed latency or delayed fills.Account sharing or copying trades across unrelated user accounts.Reverse arbitrage or hedging between two opposing Blastrr accounts.

items.question: Is there a maximum leverage cap or position size threshold?
items.answer: Yes. Leverage limits depend on the asset class:Crypto Pairs: Up to 1:20 leverage.Forex Majors: Up to 1:100 leverage.Indices & Commodities: Up to 1:50 leverage.

items.question: Can I hold positions overnight or across weekend market closures?
items.answer: Yes. Holding positions overnight and over weekends is allowed on all Blastrr accounts, provided your account margin requirements are maintained.

items.question: Are certain assets or pairs restricted on Blastrr accounts?
items.answer: No. You may trade any asset active on the Blastrr terminal, including crypto perpetuals, forex pairs, and major market indices.

items.question: Is automated API trading or EA execution supported?
items.answer: Yes. Algorithmic execution, custom Expert Advisors (EAs), and Web3 API webhooks are supported as long as they comply with our general strategy and risk policies.

items.question: Can I manually top up or deposit extra funds into an active account?
items.answer: No. You cannot add external funds to an active simulated account balance. If an account is breached, you may choose to reset the account for a discounted fee.

items.question: What specific risk limits apply to a Blastrr account?
items.answer: Every account is monitored by automated risk engine parameters:Daily Loss Limit: Typically set to 4% or 5% of the starting day's equity.Maximum Drawdown: Set to 8% or 10% relative to initial virtual capital.

items.question: Is the Maximum Drawdown trailing, end-of-day, or static?
items.answer: Evaluation Accounts: Feature a Trailing Drawdown that trails high-water equity until reaching the initial starting balance, where it locks as a static floor.Instant Accounts: Feature a fixed Static Drawdown calculated directly from starting account capital.

items.question: How is the Daily Loss Limit calculated and enforced?
items.answer:
The Daily Loss Limit resets at 00:00 UTC each day. It is calculated as:
$$\text{Max Daily Equity Floor} = \text{Starting Equity at 00:00 UTC} \times (1 - \text{Daily Loss \%})$$
If your open floating equity or closed balance touches this threshold, the account is automatically closed for the remainder of the trading day or invalidated.

items.question: What happens immediately if an account breaches a risk parameter?
items.answer: If a risk threshold is touched, the risk management system automatically closes all open positions, cancels pending orders, and transitions the account status to Breached.

items.question: Can a breached account be reset or restored?
items.answer: A breached account cannot be un-breached. However, users can purchase an Account Reset at a discounted rate to receive a new account instance with fresh virtual capital.

items.question: What financial markets and assets can I trade on Blastrr?
items.answer: Blastrr provides access to simulated markets across top Digital Assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, LUN), Major/Minor Forex pairs, Gold, Oil, and Global Stock Indices.

items.question: When are markets open and accessible?
items.answer: Crypto markets are available 24/7/365. Forex, Commodities, and Indices follow standard global financial market session hours (Sunday 17:00 EST to Friday 17:00 EST).

items.question: What order types (Limit, Market, Stop) are supported?
items.answer: The terminal supports standard Market execution, Limit entry orders, Stop-Limit orders, and inline Stop Loss / Take Profit parameters.

items.question: How do I set or adjust Stop Loss (SL) and Take Profit (TP) targets?
items.answer: You can set SL and TP values directly in the order entry panel when opening a position, or drag-and-drop the price lines on the visual trading chart to adjust them in real-time.

items.question: How does simulated cross-margin work on Blastrr?
items.answer: Cross-margin aggregates your total open simulated equity across active positions to back open trades, giving you flexibility while requiring active management to prevent margin call liquidations.

items.question: How do perpetual contracts work, and do they expire?
items.answer: Perpetual crypto contracts on Blastrr do not expire. Positions can be held indefinitely as long as your account maintains sufficient virtual margin and avoids liquidation.

items.question: How is the funding rate calculated and applied on open positions?
items.answer: Funding rates update every 8 hours on perpetual positions to align simulated prices with spot indexes. Depending on market tilt (long vs. short), funding payments are automatically credited or debited from your open position equity.

items.question: What simulated trading fees or spreads apply on Blastrr?
items.answer: Blastrr uses raw institutional spreads with a flat simulated commission structure (e.g., $3.50 per lot traded on Forex, 0.04% taker fee on Crypto perpetuals).

items.question: What is the difference between Mark Price and Mid Price execution?
items.answer: Mid Price: The average price between the current highest bid and lowest ask.Mark Price: A smoothed index price used to calculate unrealized PnL and trigger risk closures, protecting traders from sudden orderbook spikes or artificial slippage.

items.question: How do automated simulated liquidations function?
items.answer: If your usable virtual margin reaches 0%, the trading engine triggers a forced liquidation, systematically closing your largest open positions to protect the account from negative equity.

items.question: Why might my realized PnL differ slightly from my unrealized profit shown before I closed?
items.answer: Differences are typically caused by dynamic spread expansion, small execution slippage during rapid price movements, or accrued funding rate adjustments applied at the exact moment of closing.

items.question: How do I modify or cancel pending open orders?
items.answer: Navigate to the Open Orders tab at the bottom of your trading interface and click the Cancel (X) button or edit the entry price directly on your chart.

items.question: How do I add simulated test tokens to a demo balance?
items.answer: If you are operating on a trial workspace or testnet environment, you can request extra test assets by clicking Faucet or Reset Balance in your dashboard header.

items.question: What is the minimum simulated deposit requirement?
items.answer: There is no real minimum deposit since all capital is virtual. Starter testnet balances typically default to $1,000 or $10,000 in simulated test tokens.

items.question: Which networks or testnets are supported for token connections?
items.answer: Blastrr supports Solana Devnet/Mainnet wallet verification as well as EVM-compatible networks (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base) for viewing and claiming tokens.

items.question: How long do simulated balance updates take to reflect in the terminal?
items.answer: Simulated balance updates and faucet distributions reflect instantly on the trading terminal canvas upon blockchain block confirmation.

items.question: My simulated balance has not updated. What troubleshooting steps should I take?
items.answer: Ensure your Web3 wallet is connected to the correct network.Hard refresh your browser page (Ctrl + F5 or Cmd + Shift + R).Clear your browser cache or disconnect and reconnect your wallet.

items.question: What is the difference between a Reward Claim and a Standard Token Transfer?
items.answer: A Reward Claim is a performance reward requested through Blastrr's automated portal after achieving virtual profits on a Funded Account. A standard token transfer is simply moving existing tokens between wallets.

items.question: How does profit sharing and reward eligibility work on a Funded Account?
items.answer: When you generate simulated net profits on a Blastrr Funded Account while adhering to all risk rules, you become eligible to request a reward payout based on your agreed profit split.

items.question: What is the percentage profit split for eligible participants?
items.answer: Standard Blastrr Funded Accounts come with an 80/20 profit split (80% to the user, 20% to the platform). Traders can upgrade to a 90/10 profit split via add-on features.

items.question: How frequently can I submit a claim for simulated performance rewards?
items.answer: First claims can be submitted 14 days after placing your first trade on a Funded Account. Subsequent claims can be requested bi-weekly or monthly based on your account level.

items.question: Is there a minimum profit threshold required before filing a claim?
items.answer: Yes. The minimum claim threshold is $100 in eligible simulated profit.

items.question: Which Web3 wallets and blockchain networks are supported for submitting claims?
items.answer: Claims can be processed via Solana (Phantom, Solflare) or EVM networks (Metamask, Coinbase Wallet) in major stablecoins (USDC/USDT) or native project tokens ($LUN).

items.question: How do I specify the wallet address where my claimed reward should be sent?
items.answer: When filling out the Claim Reward form on your dashboard, enter your public wallet address or select your connected Web3 identity.

items.question: Where can I inspect my historical claim submissions and account payouts?
items.answer: All past claims, verification timestamps, transaction hashes, and reward statuses are permanently recorded under the Payout History tab of your user dashboard.

items.question: My claim request shows as processing. How long does verification take?
items.answer: Claim verifications are typically audited and processed within 24 to 48 hours of submission.

items.question: Is identity verification or additional documentation required prior to a first reward payout?
items.answer: Yes. To ensure compliance and prevent multi-account fraud, users must complete a quick 2-minute KYC/AML identity verification check (ID scan + selfie) prior to receiving their first payout.

items.question: Are Blastrr accounts backed by real financial market trades?
items.answer: No. Blastrr operates strictly as a simulated performance platform. All order execution occurs within a simulated environment using synthetic orderbooks and virtual capital. No real trades are routed to live exchange books.

items.question: Is there any guarantee or promise of payment when participating in evaluations?
items.answer: No. Blastrr does not guarantee, promise, or warrant any financial compensation, fixed return, or payment. All payouts represent performance-based reward allocations subject to explicit adherence to platform terms and verification approval.

items.question: Why does Blastrr operate exclusively using simulated capital?
items.answer: Operating with simulated capital provides a safe, controlled ecosystem for traders to demonstrate skill without incurring personal financial risk, while enabling Blastrr to identify top-tier trading talent based on objective performance metrics.
